segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal quote and make sure the seat count and dates line up before I send it to procurement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 seats today, but we need to add 8 for the support team, so 50 total starting September 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 50 seats effective September 1. The current term ends August 31, so we can just make the renewal a clean 12-month term, September 1 through August 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can you confirm the price? Finance asked me to keep it under $36,000 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so with the volume tier on the pricing sheet, 50 seats comes to $58 per seat per month. Annualized, that’s $34,800 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that should be fine. Will the invoice be one annual invoice, same as this year?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, one invoice, net 30. I’ll make sure the billing tool has the PO required flag on it. Do you have the new PO number yet?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Not yet. I should have it by Friday. You can send the order form without it, and I’ll route it once procurement adds the PO.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form this afternoon with the 50 seats, September 1 start, annual billing, net 30. No changes to the standard terms from last year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you can copy Marcus from procurement, that’ll help keep it moving. We’re trying to have it signed by August 23.
